corrections.text: The Analysis section states Australia's under-16 social media ban was backed by fines that "started at A$49.5 million and were doubled to A$99 million," citing Euronews. The cited Euronews article confirms the penalty was doubled to A$99 million (€63mn) but does not state the original, pre-doubling fine amount anywhere in the piece. The A$49.5 million starting figure could not be verified against the cited source.
